Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach

![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png)
Polish Championships is the most important competition in calendar of any Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it brings best competitors who fight for Polish Champion titles in all official events in fair play atmosphere.

### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for the Polish Speedcubing Championship 2025 in Warsaw.**
In our view, a national championship should be reserved for the citizens of that country. This is just one of around 70 competitions held in Poland each year – you are more than welcome to attend any of the others.
